data.name: Mummy Rot
data.description: Curse and disease-slam; save Fort DC 18; onset 1 minute; frequency 1/day; effect 1d6 Con and 1d6 Cha; cure -. This otherwise functions like standard mummy rot. The DC is Charisma-based and includes a +2 racial bonus.
